name: certificate-card
title: Certificate card
description: A certificate of completion as a card: recipient, course, dates, a copyable credential ID, and download and verify actions that still read in black and white.
docs: recipient and title are set large inside a double frame, with issuer, issuedAt and expiresAt in a labelled list in locale and timeZone (a day such as '2026-01-12' never shifts with the zone). credentialId is a mono value you can copy. verifyHref is a link that opens in a new tab (rel noopener) and says so to screen readers; onDownload may return a promise, and the button then shows a spinner until it settles. A certificate whose expiresAt has passed, or one you mark with expired, says 'Expired on 3 Mar 2026' in a badge and mutes its frame and seal (the list then leaves the end date out, because the badge has it); left to the clock it reads as valid until the page is live, so the server and the browser agree. The card is an article whose heading is the title (headingLevel sets its level), and when it is printed the buttons give way to the address that verifies it and every border and text falls back to black on white, on a dark page as well. labels carries every word.
